nodes.name: Bill Clinton
nodes.note: US president 1993–2001. In 2000 he pardoned Al Schwimmer, convicted in 1950 under the Neutrality Acts for exporting aircraft to the Haganah.

nodes.name: George W. Bush
nodes.note: US president 2001–2009. In December 2008 he granted a posthumous pardon to Charles Winters, convicted for his part in the 1948 aircraft exports to the Haganah.
